stem: Which description is an example of an unalienable right from the Declaration of Independence?

options.label: A
options.text: Equality — People’s education should be equal in every state.

options.label: B
options.text: Wealth — People’s salaries should be dependent on their skills.

options.label: C
options.text: Happiness — People can do lawful things that they enjoy.

options.label: D
options.text: Patriotism — People can choose to join any of the armed forces.
